tasks.title: Executor modes
tasks.objective: FORGE_EXECUTOR decides who writes for the whole repository: hybrid (default) and codex keep today's Codex writers; claude makes Claude and its subagents the writers everywhere, under the same gates, with no Codex needed.
acceptance_criteria: With no FORGE_EXECUTOR set in a Claude-coordinated session the executor is hybrid and behaviour is unchanged: a Claude product edit is refused and forge delegate starts Codex.
With FORGE_EXECUTOR=codex behaviour is unchanged from today.

With FORGE_EXECUTOR=claude, forge delegate records a Claude writer entry for the active task without starting Codex, and the Claude session and its subagents may write only inside the task's effective scope; protected markers stay refused.
With FORGE_EXECUTOR=claude, forge fix records a Claude writer entry for the open Lite window, and Claude edits are admitted only within the window's file budget.

With FORGE_EXECUTOR=claude on a machine without Codex, forge doctor (fast, full and --fix) passes without installing Codex, the task grill hands its cold read to a fresh Claude subagent, and task close accepts the Claude writer entry as write proof and reviews with the claude engine.

A Codex-coordinated session refuses any FORGE_EXECUTOR other than unset or codex in delegate, doctor, the write hook and close, and an unknown value is refused everywhere with hybrid, codex and claude listed.

reviewer_focus: Apply constitution/09-agent-conduct.md sections 2-4 and Ponytail: one resolver, reuse of host-native preparation and admission, no new ledger, schema or hook-written evidence.
Prove hybrid by default behaves exactly as before until a Claude writer record exists. The Claude session stays locked, and the companion launch, lock and close path are unchanged.

Prove Claude writer admission is the existing native stage admission: exactly one active stage, a preparation bound to stage, brief, contract digest and narrowed effective scope, path-in-scope on every target, and opaque Bash and marker refusals kept.

Prove close accepts the Claude writer record only in hybrid or claude mode, with codex mode still requiring a successful companion launch (wording 'no successful write launch' kept), and that Codex-coordinated sessions refuse any non-codex setting while their native branch is untouched.

Confirm claude mode needs no Codex: doctor demotes only codex rows, grill prepares a fresh host reader through the existing preparation path, review defaults to the claude engine, and Lite stays on its current route.

tasks.title: Pinned SDK and doctor check
tasks.objective: Pinned openai-codex in a Forge-managed environment, minimum codex binary, doctor check and repair, docs; the route stays off.
acceptance_criteria: The SDK is pinned and the binary checked against the SDK minimum; a mismatch names both versions
doctor --fix installs the pinned SDK and the minimum codex binary when needed

tasks.title: Supervisor and lease
tasks.objective: One detached supervisor per Git common directory owns the lease and app-server behind a private socket; takeover only of a provably dead holder.
acceptance_criteria: Only the lease holder resumes Forge threads; a stale lease is cleared; live or uncertain holders are refused
The socket and token are owner-only on POSIX and DACL-protected on Windows

tasks.title: Admission and close parity
tasks.objective: Per-turn ledger rows, admission and close parity with terminal-turn proof, sticky routes, declining approval handler; the route switches on with a first real delegation.
acceptance_criteria: Every SDK turn is admitted by a recorded ledger row and close needs a terminal turn
Routes are sticky per task; a task with a companion launch stays on the plugin
An unexpected approval request is declined and logged

tasks.title: Resume the worker for fix rounds
tasks.objective: Review-fix rounds resume the task's worker thread with a verified snapshot; drift starts fresh; benchmark evidence recorded.
acceptance_criteria: A fix round resumes the recorded thread with brief, HEAD, diff and findings; drift starts a new thread with the reason
The recorded benchmark shows fewer uncached input tokens and less wall time for resumed rounds

tasks.title: Live events and steering
tasks.objective: Turn state machine, reattach, signals bound to their turn and answered by steer or interrupt, abandon-turn recovery.
acceptance_criteria: A lost stream reattaches and an unknown turn blocks close
A signal resolution reaches the exact active turn and its delivery is recorded

tasks.title: Upgrade, cleanup and parity
tasks.objective: Client upgrade path, archival and pruning, parity matrix, end-to-end runs in throwaway clients.
acceptance_criteria: forge upgrade adds the SDK route idempotently and plugin tasks finish on the plugin
Threads archive at task merge and story outcome; pruning touches ledger threads only
The parity matrix passes on Ubuntu and Windows CI plus local macOS observations
